evidence: Documents tab lists all 19 documents with module filter buttons (All, API, AUTH, DATA, UI, CORE); clicking a module filter narrows the list accordingly, confirming documents are organized/browsable by module.

Document view (e.g. 'REST API Design Guidelines') renders an h1 title, a 'Content Sections' region listing collapsible sections with content, and a 'Related Documents' region listing related doc buttons.

Clicking a Related Documents button (e.g. 'OAuth 2.0 Integration' from JWT Authentication) or an expanded in-section link navigates the viewer to the target document via setSelectedDocumentId, confirmed both by source (handleRelatedDocClick/handleLinkClick in DocumentViewer.tsx and DocumentSection.tsx) and live UI navigation between documents.

Clicking a section header (e.g. 'REST Principles') toggles isSectionExpanded/toggleSection, expanding to reveal paragraph content and links, or collapsing back to header-only; observed both states in snapshots (expanded 'REST Principles' vs collapsed 'Endpoint Naming Conventions').
Knowledge Graph tab renders an SVG graph with one node per document (19 nodes matching the 19 documents in data) with a module color legend (5 modules), and nodes are clickable/interactive.
Knowledge Graph view provides Zoom In / Zoom Out / Reset View controls with a live percentage indicator (e.g. '100%' → '140%') that updates in response to control clicks.
Top navigation exposes three tabs (Documents, Knowledge Graph, Favorites); clicking each switches the main content region accordingly with no errors.

Clicking 'Add to favorites' on 'REST API Design Guidelines' immediately updated the Favorites tab badge from 2 to 3 in the very next snapshot (real-time, no reload needed); clicking 'Remove from favorites' reverted it to 2.

localStorage key 'tech-docs-storage' persists favorites, sectionStates (expanded/collapsed per doc/section), graphState.zoom/pan, selectedModule and sortBy; switching tabs (Documents → Graph → Favorites → Documents) preserved section expand/collapse state and graph zoom level across the switch.
Typing 'zzznonexistentqueryxyz' into the 'Search documents...' textbox filtered the list to zero results in real time; clearing the field restored the full 19-document list.

Module filter buttons (All/API/AUTH/DATA/UI/CORE) narrow the document list, and the Sort combobox (Title / Last Updated / Module) re-orders the list; both controls function without errors and favorites remain correctly flagged (star state) across re-sorted/filtered views.

Programmatic extraction of all 19 documents' ids vs. their own relatedDocs arrays and section links from /src/data/documents.ts confirmed no document references its own id (no self-referencing links or relatedDocs entries) in the shipped static dataset.

Knowledge Graph node count (19) exactly matches the 19 documents in documents.ts, and the graph's module color legend (5 entries) exactly matches the 5 modules defined in moduleInfo (api, auth, data, ui, core).

Injected a synthetic invalid link ('Broken Link Test' → docId 'totally-fake-doc-xyz') into the expanded 'REST Principles' section via live module mutation; clicking the rendered button produced the toast 'Document not found. The link may be invalid.', confirming graceful handling of invalid links (handleLinkClick in DocumentSection.tsx). Related Documents list also silently filters out an injected invalid relatedDocs entry ('nonexistent-doc-id') rather than crashing.

Section header chevron icon toggles the 'rotate-180' class (confirmed via getAttribute('class') and getComputedStyle(icon).transform matrix change) when a section is expanded vs collapsed, providing a clear visual indicator of state; additionally, links within a collapsed section render visually disabled (opacity-60, cursor-not-allowed, title='Expand section to access link') and clicking them shows a 'Please expand the section to access links' warning toast rather than navigating.

Searching for a nonexistent term ('zzznonexistentqueryxyz') in the Documents tab displayed a graceful 'No documents found' heading with helper text 'Try adjusting your search or filter criteria' instead of an empty/blank list or error.
